answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the anchor of a task receipt, and the ripple is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
